lesson.en: A rejected container costs the goods and some trust, whatever you do next. Fixing the cause is what stops it from costing the relationship too.
lesson.sw: Kontena lililozuiwa linagharimu bidhaa na imani kiasi, chochote utakachofanya baadaye. Kurekebisha chanzo ndicho kinachozuia kisigharimu uhusiano pia.

label.en: Dispute the rejection and insist the goods were fine
label.sw: Pinga uzuiaji na sisitiza bidhaa zilikuwa sawa

detail.en: No process change. The buyer hears you deny a problem they experienced directly.
detail.sw: Hakuna mabadiliko ya mchakato. Mnunuzi anasikia ukikataa tatizo alilolipitia moja kwa moja.

outcome.en: The port's decision stands regardless. The buyer is now dealing with both a held container and a supplier who would not acknowledge it.
outcome.sw: Uamuzi wa bandari unabaki hata hivyo. Mnunuzi sasa anashughulikia kontena lililozuiwa na msambazaji ambaye hakukubali hilo.

lesson.en: Disputing a fact the buyer already experienced does not undo it. It adds a second problem — trust — to the first one.
lesson.sw: Kupinga ukweli ambao mnunuzi tayari ameupitia hakuufuti. Kunaongeza tatizo la pili — imani — kwa la kwanza.

cause.en: the disputed rejection, which the buyer's head office had heard about directly
cause.sw: uzuiaji uliopingwa, ambao ofisi kuu ya mnunuzi ilikuwa imesikia moja kwa moja

label.en: Proactively recall the batch and recertify before the next shipment
label.sw: Rejesha kundi hilo kwa hiari na uthibitishe upya kabla ya shehena inayofuata

detail.en: The most costly response today, and the clearest signal to the buyer.
detail.sw: Jibu la gharama kubwa zaidi leo, na ishara wazi zaidi kwa mnunuzi.

outcome.en: You recall the batch and pay for an independent recheck before the next shipment goes out. It costs more this week than the other responses, and the buyer notices.
outcome.sw: Unarejesha kundi hilo na kulipia ukaguzi huru kabla shehena inayofuata haijasafirishwa. Kunagharimu zaidi wiki hii kuliko majibu mengine, na mnunuzi anaona.

lesson.en: The most expensive response to a failure is sometimes the one that actually protects the relationship it threatened.
lesson.sw: Jibu la gharama kubwa zaidi kwa kushindwa wakati mwingine ndilo linalolinda kweli uhusiano ulioutishia.

cause.en: the proactive recall and recertification that rebuilt the buyer's confidence
cause.sw: kurejesha kwa hiari na kuthibitisha upya kulikorejesha imani ya mnunuzi

situation.en: The Gulf distributor offers a much larger order on the condition that it ships under their own brand, with no mention of your plant on the packaging. Your name and reputation stay a domestic and regional matter.
situation.sw: Msambazaji wa Ghuba anatoa oda kubwa zaidi kwa sharti kwamba isafirishwe chini ya chapa yao wenyewe, bila kutajwa kwa kiwanda chako kwenye ufungashaji. Jina lako na sifa yako vinabaki suala la ndani na kikanda.

label.en: Weigh the order size against what carries your name
label.sw: Linganisha ukubwa wa oda dhidi ya kile kinachobeba jina lako

reveals.en: A private-label order is usually larger because the buyer is taking on the marketing and the risk of a brand no one abroad knows yet. It also means the reputation you build there is theirs, not yours.
reveals.sw: Oda ya chapa ya mtu mwingine kwa kawaida ni kubwa zaidi kwa sababu mnunuzi anachukua uuzaji na hatari ya chapa ambayo hakuna anayeijua nje bado. Pia inamaanisha sifa unayojenga huko ni yao, si yako.

prompt.en: Do you accept the private-label order?
prompt.sw: Unakubali oda ya chapa ya mtu mwingine?

predictQuestion.en: What happens to your weekly profit?

label.en: Keep your own brand and take the smaller order
label.sw: Weka chapa yako mwenyewe na uchukue oda ndogo

detail.en: Slower growth abroad. Your name is what builds a reputation there.
detail.sw: Ukuaji wa polepole nje. Jina lako ndilo linalojenga sifa huko.

outcome.en: The distributor agrees to the smaller order, under your name. It grows slower, and whatever reputation it earns abroad belongs to the plant.
outcome.sw: Msambazaji anakubali oda ndogo, chini ya jina lako. Inakua polepole, na sifa yoyote inayopatikana nje ni ya kiwanda.

lesson.en: Keeping your own name abroad is slower and it compounds. Reputation earned under your brand stays yours the next time you sell it.
lesson.sw: Kuweka jina lako nje ni polepole na linakua taratibu. Sifa iliyopatikana chini ya chapa yako inabaki yako mara nyingine unapouza.

label.sw: Kubali oda kubwa ya chapa ya mtu mwingine

detail.en: The bigger volume, with no mention of the plant on the box.
detail.sw: Kiasi kikubwa zaidi, bila kutajwa kwa kiwanda kwenye boksi.

outcome.en: The larger order is confirmed under the distributor's own brand. Volume grows sharply, and none of the credit for it reaches your name abroad.
outcome.sw: Oda kubwa zaidi inathibitishwa chini ya chapa ya msambazaji mwenyewe. Kiasi kinakua sana, na hakuna sifa yake inayofikia jina lako nje.

lesson.en: Private label can be the faster path to volume. It trades a brand you own for a customer you serve, and both are legitimate ways to grow.
lesson.sw: Chapa ya mtu mwingine inaweza kuwa njia ya haraka zaidi kwa kiasi. Inabadilisha chapa unayomiliki kwa mteja unayemhudumia, na zote ni njia halali za kukua.

label.en: Decline both and continue with the current order as it stands
label.sw: Kataa zote mbili na uendelee na oda ya sasa kama ilivyo

detail.en: No new commitment either way this week.
detail.sw: Hakuna ahadi mpya upande wowote wiki hii.

outcome.en: You tell the distributor you need more time to consider it. The current order continues as before.
outcome.sw: Unamwambia msambazaji unahitaji muda zaidi kufikiria. Oda ya sasa inaendelea kama awali.

lesson.en: Brand or private label is not a decision that has to be made the moment it is offered. Both paths stay open a little longer.
lesson.sw: Chapa yako au ya mtu mwingine si uamuzi unaopaswa kufanywa muda huo huo unapotolewa. Njia zote mbili zinabaki wazi kidogo zaidi.

conceptLabel.sw: Mauzo ya rekodi, pesa mbaya zaidi

situation.en: Export orders are at record levels. The profit line looks better than it ever has. When you count the bank, the cash is tighter than it has been all year. Read the ledger before you decide what to do.
situation.sw: Oda za nje ziko kwenye kiwango cha rekodi. Mstari wa faida unaonekana bora kuliko ulivyowahi kuwa. Ukihesabu benki, pesa ni ngumu zaidi kuliko ilivyokuwa mwaka mzima. Soma daftari kabla ya kuamua hatua.

label.en: Trace one export sale from shipping to being paid
label.sw: Fuatilia mauzo moja ya nje kutoka kusafirisha hadi kulipwa

reveals.en: Wages, freight and duty are paid before the buyer settles the invoice. The longer the credit terms behind the record sales, the more of that profit is sitting with buyers rather than in the bank.
reveals.sw: Mishahara, usafirishaji na ushuru vinalipwa kabla mnunuzi hajalipia ankara. Masharti marefu zaidi ya mkopo nyuma ya mauzo ya rekodi, ndivyo faida hiyo inavyokaa zaidi kwa wanunuzi badala ya benki.

prompt.en: Which ledger line explains why profit is up while cash is worse than ever?
prompt.sw: Ni mstari gani wa daftari unaoeleza kwa nini faida imepanda huku pesa ikiwa mbaya zaidi kuliko wakati wowote?

right.en: Working capital is the line. The credit terms behind the record export orders mean more money than ever is sitting with buyers who have not paid yet, even as the sales themselves are already counted as profit.
right.sw: Working capital ndiyo mstari huo. Masharti ya mkopo nyuma ya oda za rekodi za nje yanamaanisha pesa zaidi kuliko wakati wowote inakaa kwa wanunuzi ambao bado hawajalipa, hata mauzo yenyewe tayari yamehesabiwa kama faida.

wrong.en: That line explains part of the profit picture, not the missing bank money. Look for cash that is earned but not yet collected.
wrong.sw: Mstari huo unaeleza sehemu ya picha ya faida, si pesa ya benki iliyokosekana. Tafuta pesa iliyopatikana lakini bado haijakusanywa.

prompt.en: What do you change now?
prompt.sw: Unabadilisha nini sasa?

predictQuestion.en: What happens to your weekly profit?

label.en: Renegotiate credit terms shorter across the export book
label.sw: Jadili upya masharti ya mkopo yawe mafupi kwenye kitabu chote cha nje

detail.en: Less money sitting with buyers. The sales themselves do not change.
detail.sw: Pesa kidogo inakaa kwa wanunuzi. Mauzo yenyewe hayabadiliki.

outcome.en: Buyers agree, some more readily than others, to shorter terms going forward. Profit does not move, and less of it will sit outside the plant.
outcome.sw: Wanunuzi wanakubali, wengine kwa urahisi zaidi kuliko wengine, masharti mafupi zaidi kuendelea mbele. Faida haibadiliki, na kidogo zaidi yake itakaa nje ya kiwanda.

lesson.en: A record week on the profit line is not the same as a healthy bank balance. Shortening the cycle behind it is how the two come back together.
lesson.sw: Wiki ya rekodi kwenye mstari wa faida si sawa na salio zuri la benki. Kufupisha mzunguko nyuma yake ndiko kunakoleta hivyo viwili pamoja tena.

label.en: Chase more export sales on the same terms
label.sw: Fukuzia mauzo zaidi ya nje kwa masharti yaleyale

detail.en: The order book is valuable. The cash gap behind it stays exactly as it is.
detail.sw: Kitabu cha oda kina thamani. Pengo la pesa nyuma yake linabaki kama lilivyo hasa.

outcome.en: More orders are confirmed on the same credit terms. Profit rises sharply, and an even larger share of it is now sitting with buyers who have not paid.
outcome.sw: Oda zaidi zinathibitishwa kwa masharti yaleyale ya mkopo. Faida inapanda sana, na sehemu kubwa zaidi yake sasa inakaa kwa wanunuzi ambao hawajalipa.

lesson.en: A record profit built on the same long cycle grows the exact problem it is celebrating. More sales are not automatically more cash.
lesson.sw: Faida ya rekodi iliyojengwa kwenye mzunguko mrefu uleule inakuza tatizo lenyewe linalosherehekewa. Mauzo zaidi si pesa zaidi kiotomatiki.

label.en: Pause new export orders and focus on collecting what is owed
label.sw: Sitisha oda mpya za nje na uzingatie kukusanya kinachodaiwa

detail.en: Less growth this week, and the plant collects on what it has already earned.
detail.sw: Ukuaji mdogo wiki hii, na kiwanda kinakusanya kile ambacho tayari kimekipata.

outcome.en: New export volume is turned away for now. This week's sales are smaller, and the collections effort has nothing new competing with it for attention.
outcome.sw: Kiasi kipya cha nje kinakataliwa kwa sasa. Mauzo ya wiki hii ni madogo, na jitihada za kukusanya hazina kitu kipya kinachoshindana nazo kwa umakini.

lesson.en: Pausing growth to collect what is already earned is a real cost today, in exchange for a cash position that matches the profit line again.
lesson.sw: Kusitisha ukuaji ili kukusanya kile ambacho tayari kimepatikana ni gharama halisi leo, badala ya hali ya pesa inayolingana na mstari wa faida tena.
